review_scope: Independent source-diff review and verification of actual single-switch network replication evidence; not reliable multicast acceptance

unicast_regression.reason: Official pinned ns-3-ub-tools parser absent; dependency visibility assertion cannot read generated task_statistics.csv. Both baseline and modified simulator complete the same reproduced dependency case, with the same missing parser output. Do not report this suite as PASS.

limitations: Network-only single-switch CBFC path; no WQE/TA reliability, transaction acknowledgment, source-side completion CQE, retransmission or member failure recovery.
Idealized destination PacketTag adds zero wire bytes; the real datalink header and CBFC control packets do consume bandwidth.
Tests use up to five NPU endpoints, not an exhaustive 64-rank mask/topology test.
No multi-switch forwarding, transport congestion-control semantics or UltraEP integration tested for tagged packets.
Native regression is QUICK under the current MPI/MTP-disabled build; the external-parser-dependent suite remains unavailable.
No exhaustive fuzz or sanitizer campaign; negative cases and evidence mutations cover the stated faults, not every possible invalid external input.
review_resolution: Initial DWRR upstream-credit suppression omission was found during review and corrected before runtime acceptance. No remaining correctness blocker found within the tested network-only scope.
